style.palette: ETRI blue #005EB8, navy text, pure white, pale blue research modules, muted gray supporting infrastructure
style.typography: Large impeccably readable Korean sans, title ~44px equivalent; short labels, generous whitespace
style.rules: 16:9 full slide image; no page numbers; no decorative stripes; ETRI wordmark at upper right as approved sample. One main diagram, maximum three explanation groups; do not repeat long footer sentences.

deck_context.core_claim: ETRI analyzed NPU execution conditions and low-level paths, implemented custom-stage replacement and actual KV-transfer NPU PD runtimes, and developed lmd-top for model operations. These are separate research implementations, not one finished automatic controller.
deck_context.narrative: 1 whole map → 2 conditions problem → 3 low-level entry points → 4 custom code integration → 5 stage separation → 6 operations → 7 collaboration return to map.
deck_context.facts: Hardware/vendor compiler/Kubernetes/Prometheus are reused infrastructure, not ETRI inventions. PD is a split execution method, not IR. Do not claim GPU-NPU PD completed: completed PD records are RNGD/ATOM. No benchmark numbers. May not claim all custom kernels verified. lmd-top manages vendor compile Jobs, not compiler itself.

slides.title: 이종 자원 관리, 우리는 어디를 개발했나
장비뿐 아니라 실행 조건도 선택해야 합니다
slides.intent: Zoom into model preparation: show why resource management must include compile settings.
slides.layout: One large model icon on left branches into only THREE artifact sheets in middle with distinct simple shape/config symbols, then converges toward a modest NPU outline right. Label model '모델', artifact group '조건별 아티팩트', destination 'NPU 실행'. Below main diagram two concise result dimensions '실행 성능' and '컴파일 시간·파일 크기'. Tiny breadcrumb '전체 환경 → 실행 조건'. Do not turn into three equal text cards.
slides.local_context: We compared bucket/parallel settings and compile time/artifact size. No claim all GPUs dynamic or all NPUs static. This is used NPU path.
constraints: Exact Korean title and listed text; no invented charts or numbers; match sample palette but use a branching flow composition.

slides.title: 실행을 바꾸기 위해 내부 계층을 분석했습니다
slides.intent: From settings problem, descend into the interfaces where we can intervene.
slides.layout: Three broad steps descending from upper left to lower right, linked by subtle arrows. First module graph icon and labels 'DSL · 모듈 구성'; second stylized memory blocks HBM↔DM and labels 'Rust LIR · 연산 매핑'; third binary file icon and labels '바이너리 · 실행 연결'. Use a focused enlarged middle memory-path diagram with just HBM, DMA, DM, 연산; no hardware numeric specifications. Tiny breadcrumb '컴파일·런타임 계층 확대'.
slides.local_context: Provided custom-kernel guide describes Python DSL, Rust LIR, module compile and artifact paths. ETRI analyzed entry points, data movement, and mappings; did not author vendor whole compiler.
constraints: No L1-L8 taxonomy list, no code dumps, no benchmark numbers; distinguish IR analysis from PD.

slides.title: 기존 엔진에 우리 실행 코드를 연결했습니다
slides.intent: Explain concrete ETRI implementation L8Swapper, not generic custom kernel possibility.
slides.layout: Large before/after two parallel horizontal pipelines. Before muted-gray chain of 5 stage blocks, one central stage outlined. After identical 5-stage chain, ONLY middle block blue labeled '우리 코드', others gray. Center between rows a small wrench/tool label 'L8Swapper' and curved replacement arrow; make pipeline matching obvious. Header labels '기존 아티팩트' and '수정된 아티팩트'. At bottom one compact process '규격 확인 → 교체·저장 → 실행 확인'. Tiny breadcrumb '저수준 분석 → 커스텀 실행'.
slides.local_context: L8Swapper is ETRI tool to compile/replace stage binary in vendor artifact and validate dispatch. Rust verification includes passthrough dispatch, not full attention replacement correctness. No code or implementation API list.
constraints: Don't imply whole engine rewritten or all layers replaced. Preserve visual identity, vary to comparison layout.

slides.title: 실제 KV를 넘겨 NPU 사이에서 실행을 나눴습니다
slides.intent: Extend from replacing a stage to placing execution phases on different NPUs.
slides.layout: One spacious three-part horizontal diagram. Left distinct blue processor+input tokens, center KV memory buffer with transfer arrows, right processor+output token sequence. Labels beneath left/right 'NPU A' / 'NPU B'. Blue connector caption '직접 구현한 KV 전송 경로'. Bottom modest text 'Furiosa ↔ Rebellions' and '동종·이종 조합 / 역할 교환'. A restrained small callout 'KV 유지·연산 배치·컴파일 조건도 분석'. Tiny breadcrumb '커스텀 실행 → 단계 분리'.
slides.local_context: Actual RNGD/ATOM KV handoff implemented via own runtime; shm serving and separate TCP tests. Not GPU→NPU completion, not a claim generic network remote server placement. lmd-top is not this runtime/controller. Initial re-prefill emulation not current illustrated work.
constraints: No performance gain number or always-faster claim. Large diagram and readable concise Korean labels.

slides.title: 준비와 운영을 lmd-top에서 연결했습니다
slides.intent: Return upward to operations after low-level and PD discussion; only one lmd-top slide.
slides.layout: Actual supplied TUI screenshot LARGE on right occupying ~68% width, fit entire original without cutting text; left ~26% has THREE brief numbered callouts with exact listed points, broken to two short lines if needed. No other dashboard or fake terminal. Small top breadcrumb '실행 계층 → 모델 운영'. Small caption under screenshot '실제 터미널 녹화 화면'. Avoid overlaying UI or modifying its values.

required_images.role: STRICT INPUT ACTUAL UI. Embed original screenshot unchanged, keep all text/colors/values/pixels visually faithful. Not loose inspiration. Do not redraw fake UI.

slides.local_context: Screenshot is real observe PTY frame, not synthetic. Failed/Degraded/Scaled-0 and missing data are real state at capture. lmd-top manages vendor Jobs not compilation itself, and no completed automatic PD control.
constraints: Must preserve strict input screenshot faithfully; if cannot include it, return blocker, do not draw a mock screenshot. No performance claims. Color styling around screenshot matches approved sample.

slides.title: 다음은 조건·단계·장비를 함께 고르는 정책입니다
slides.intent: Close top-down loop with a clean map linking existing work to proposed research, not a completed controller.
key_points: 분석 자료 · 실행 경로 · 운영 도구
slides.layout: Simplified whole map echoes sample with three aligned tiers labeled '실행 조건', '실행 단계', '모델 운영', each pale blue with small simple icon. A bracket on left labels '확보한 기반'. On right a distinct outlined (not solid completed) research area labeled '협업할 질문', containing just two large questions '언제 실행을 나눌까?' and '어떤 설정·장비를 고를까?'. Dotted arrow from base map toward outlined proposed research. Bottom short conclusion '비용 예측과 자원 배치 정책으로 연결'. No hardware photos needed; this is a conceptual callback not copy of sample.
slides.local_context: Compiler cost/shape/parallel prediction and KV-transfer-aware phase/device placement are joint research proposals, not finished automatic optimization. ETRI work includes independent low-level tools, PD runtimes, lmd-top.
constraints: Clearly distinguish completed foundations vs future collaboration. One overview diagram, no lengthy bullets, no new technical names.
